title: Add explicit SRD spell-list parity coverage gate
description:
ChatGPT audit finding.

The class spell-list pages are correctly represented in spell.data.classes in the current pack, but source-region accounting classifies most spell-list prose as intentionally ignored spell-list headers. That makes spell-list completeness under-proved: a future regression in class spell membership could pass the source-region ledger even if the generated records no longer match the source spell lists.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add an explicit deterministic parity check that reconstructs each class spell list from the SRD spell-list source pages and compares it to generated spell.data.classes.
- Check Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, and Wizard.
- The check should fail closed on missing spell names, extra spell names, wrong spell level grouping, or wrong class membership.
- The source-region ledger/report should stop describing actual spell-list content as merely ignored header prose, or should clearly point to the explicit spell-list parity check as the owning proof.
- Add regression tests or a generated audit artifact that makes spell-list coverage reviewable without relying on hotspot sampling.
close_reason: Added spellListParityAudit: re-scans the class spell-list source pages independently of applyClassLists and cross-checks against emitted spell records (missing/extra class membership + wrong level), wired as a fail-closed import-time gate. Zero findings against the committed pack.
